title: Surreal Vortex Portal
description: A lone figure in a long coat stands on a reflective path at the center of a massive swirling vortex of purple, green and white clouds. The vortex is framed by an ornate, decaying circular border filled with intricate mechanical and organic debris.
prompt: A solitary figure in a long coat stands on a narrow reflective path leading into an immense swirling vortex of purple and green clouds that spirals toward a bright center. The entire circular composition is framed by a thick ornate decaying border containing intricate mechanical parts, chains, bones and organic forms in purple, green and gold tones, surreal dreamscape, atmospheric lighting, reflective water surface below with geometric structures, painted in detailed oil painting style
